integrity: New mathematical claim supplied with detailed analytic proof and a deterministic supplementary finite verifier. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real finite-dimensional ℓp for 1<p<∞ and strictly positive weights only. In dimensions three and higher, exact modulus is expressed as finitely many explicit linear operator norms, not universally in radicals. Quantitative finite tests are not substitutes for the analytic proof. Prior contractive-set theorems may imply portions of qualitative classification.
title: Exact Lipschitz stability and contractivity threshold for weighted cross-polytope projections
